newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unidanmark to open new Helsinki branch.
newsitem.headline: Unidanmark to open new Helsinki branch.

text.p: Denmark's second biggest bank Unidanmark said on Thursday it was opening a new branch office in Helsinki on Friday June 13.
The bank established a representational office in the Finnish capital at the beginning of the year.

"The setting up of the branch in Helsinki is part of Unidanmark's Nordic strategy. About one year ago, we opened a branch in Stockholm, we plan to set up a branch in Oslo in the autumn," the bank said in a statement.
Unidanmark's new Helsinki branch will have a staff of 12, it said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
